name: run_diagnostic_step
description: Run one step of the diagnostic session currently in progress (opened via start_diagnostics -- see its response for the `instruction` and the list of steps under `available_tools`). Only usable while a session is in_progress; errors otherwise. Call as many steps as needed, in whatever order the instruction and the conversation with the customer call for -- there's no fixed sequence. When you have enough information to summarize the diagnosis, call the `conclude` step instead of continuing to call other steps -- this ends the session normally, so other tools become available again. If the customer wants to stop before you've reached a diagnosis, call `stop` instead.

step.description: The exact step name from start_diagnostics' `available_tools` (e.g. "get_full_system_config", "get_core_services_status", "get_dev_links_table", "services_ops", "conclude", "stop"). Never invented.

params.description: Parameters the step needs, e.g. {"device_id": "..."} for get_dev_links_table/get_iox_links_table, {"op": "restart"} for services_ops, or {"summary": "..."} for conclude (a short plain-language summary of the diagnosis, for the record). Omit or leave empty for steps that need nothing, like get_full_system_config, get_all_plm_links, or stop.
